name: Haunted Houses
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid adopting the occult practices and abominations of surrounding nations, emphasizing the importance of fearing God rather than man, who can only harm the body but not the soul. The Lord is sovereign over all, even mocking the efforts of those who oppose His will. Christians are called to focus their minds on what is true, pure, and praiseworthy, guarding themselves against deceptive philosophies rooted in worldly traditions rather than Christ.
